name: Simplified Checkout — Sales Funnel & One-Click Upsells
author: BeSimplified Team

sections.description:
Simplified Checkout is a WordPress/WooCommerce plugin that integrates advanced features in your checkout to enhance the experience for your customers and increase your sales potential. With Simplified Checkout, you can process transactions through a supported CRM, process subscription-type orders, and set up member portals so your customers can manage their orders and subscriptions.

This plugin connects directly to Simplified Checkout and allows you to set up 1-click upsells, sync between your CRM and WooCommerce, 1-page checkouts, and much more. A full list of the features can be found below. Learn more about Simplified Checkout >

Supported CRMs

• CheckoutChamp
• Konnektive CRM
• Sticky.io
• Vrio CRM

Built-In Features

• Connect with our supported CRMs
• Support for more payment processors and payment options (PayPal, Apple Pay & Google Pay)
• Support for subscriptions & one-time purchases
• Powerful custom checkout builder
• Create 1-click upsells, downsells, and cross-sells
• Simple tracking pixel integration
• Enhanced security with bot and malware detection and prevention
• Fraud detection and prevention
• Coupon management
• Abandoned cart recovery
• Built-in split testing
• Built-in member/customer portals
• Checkout reports and analytics
• Support for direct checkout links
• and much, much more!

If you are interested in Simplified Checkout, sign up and get started with us today!

External Services

This plugin connects to external services provided by Simplified Checkout to enable advanced checkout functionality. Below is detailed information about each service, what data is transmitted, and when these connections occur.

Important Notice: This plugin requires communication with external servers to function properly. By using this plugin, you acknowledge that data will be transmitted to third-party services as described below.

Service Provider: Simplified Checkout (BeSimplified)
Company Website: https://www.besimplified.com
Privacy Policy: https://www.besimplified.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Service: https://www.besimplified.com/terms-of-service/

1. Simplified Checkout API (api.checkout.simplified.ai)

Purpose: Core API for checkout processing, order management, and CRM integration
When data is sent:
– During plugin activation and license validation
– When processing checkout transactions
– When syncing order data with supported CRMs
– When retrieving dashboard reports and analytics

Data transmitted:
– Store URL and basic site information
– WooCommerce consumer keys and secrets (for API access)
– License key for authentication
– Order details (customer information, products, amounts)
– Cart data during checkout process

Data received:
– License validation responses
– Checkout configuration settings
– Order processing results
– Dashboard analytics and reports

2. Simplified Checkout Admin (checkout.simplified.ai)

Purpose: Administrative interface for checkout configuration and management
When data is sent:
– During initial plugin setup and account connection
– When configuring checkout settings
– When accessing the checkout builder interface

Data transmitted:
– Store URL and connection parameters
– WooCommerce consumer keys for API integration
– Basic store configuration data

Data received:
– Checkout configuration settings
– Account status and permissions
– Administrative interface content

3. Simplified Accounts (accounts.simplified.ai)

Purpose: User authentication and account management
When data is sent:
– During user login and authentication
– When managing account settings
– When accessing licensed features

Data transmitted:
– User credentials and authentication tokens
– Account identification information
– License and subscription details

Data received:
– Authentication status and tokens
– Account permissions and feature access
– User profile information

Data Security: All data transmission occurs over encrypted HTTPS connections. Simplified Checkout implements industry-standard security measures to protect transmitted data.

User Rights: Users have the right to:
– Access their personal data
– Request data correction or deletion
– Withdraw consent where applicable
– Contact support regarding data processing

Contact Information:
For questions about data processing or to exercise your rights, contact:
– Support: support@besimplified.com

User Consent and Control

Administrator Consent: By installing and activating this plugin, the site administrator consents to the data transmission described above.

End User Notice: Site administrators should inform their customers that:
– Checkout data will be processed by Simplified Checkout services
– Customer information may be shared with integrated CRM systems
– Users can review the privacy policy at: https://www.besimplified.com/privacy-policy/

Disabling External Services:
– The plugin can be deactivated to stop all external communications
– Individual features can be disabled in the plugin settings

Data Subject Requests:
If customers request access to or deletion of their data, administrators should:
1. Contact Simplified Checkout support
2. Provide necessary identification and verification

Permissions

  • Admin capabilities required: Users must have the manage_options capability to:
    • Access the Simplified Checkout settings page
    • Enable or disable Live mode
    • Re-check connection status from the admin screen

Third-party Libraries and Minified Files

This plugin includes the following third-party libraries and minified files:

Bootstrap Framework
– Files: assets/css/bootstrape.css, assets/js/bootstrape.js
– Version: Bootstrap v5.0.2 (JS) and v5.1.3 (CSS)
– Source: https://getbootstrap.com/
– License: MIT License
– GitHub Repository: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap
– Original unminified source files can be found at: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/releases
– License URL: https://github.com/twbs/bootstrap/blob/main/LICENSE

Font Awesome Icons
– Files: assets/css/font-awesome.min.css
– Version: Font Awesome v6.7.2
– Source: https://fontawesome.com/
– License: Font Awesome Free License (Icons: CC BY 4.0, Fonts: SIL OFL 1.1, Code: MIT License)
– GitHub Repository: https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome
– Original source: https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.7.2/css/all.min.css
– License URL: https://fontawesome.com/license/free

Roboto Font Family
– Files: assets/css/roboto.css, assets/fonts/roboto-*.ttf
– Source: Google Fonts – https://fonts.google.com/specimen/Roboto
– License: Apache License, Version 2.0
– Font weights included: 400 (normal), 500 (medium), 700 (bold)
– Original source: https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Roboto
– License URL: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

Build Instructions
If you need to rebuild or modify the Bootstrap files:
1. Download the source code from the Bootstrap GitHub repository
2. Follow the build instructions at: https://getbootstrap.com/docs/5.1/getting-started/build-tools/
3. Use npm and the provided build scripts to generate minified versions

Additional Information
All minified files in this plugin are from well-established open source projects. The source code for these libraries is publicly available and maintained by their respective communities. We include minified versions to reduce plugin size and improve performance, but full source code is always available through the links provided above.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the simplified-checkout-upsells folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the “Simplified Checkout” menu to configure the plugin.
